rationale: Cheapest useful Meta spend: people who already reached the campaign landing page. Works regardless of how small the prospecting audience is, because intent has already been shown.
source: Meta pixel on the campaign landing page (campaign-site), PageView event
blocked_on: The pixel is BUILT and consent-gated on the campaign landing page and its gate is tested (npm run verify:consent, 23/23 PASS, 2026-09-16). It is inert until VITE_META_PIXEL_ID is set in the campaign-site Vercel project and the page is redeployed. Nothing collects until then, and this audience needs a head start on the ads.
note: Covers campaign-page traffic only. No pixel is on www.doviloop.dev, so product-site visitors are not in this pool. campaign-site/.env.example section 5 says the same ID should go on both.
